## Review checklist

- [ ] Synthetic fixtures only; no private context or credentials.
- [ ] Preview, conflicts and repeated application tested.
- [ ] Source files and private runtime state preserved.
- [ ] Backup/restore schema compatibility considered.
- [ ] Documentation distinguishes prepared files from verified runtime behavior.
